summary: Regression-tested public Expo preview on 375x667: Hindi auth loaded, valid QA login reached agriculture dashboard, settings opened, language changed to English, and no red screen appeared. AI/backend flows were not re-executed in this iteration; prior context reports them passing.
action_items: Add data-testid/testID attributes to all interactive controls to make mobile regression automation reliable, especially bottom tabs and settings choices.
Provide an accessible label/testID for the settings back control; current automation could not identify it after language changed.
critical_code_review_comments: Interactive Pressables across auth, navigation, dashboard actions, scanner, profile, and settings generally have no testID, contrary to the requested testability contract.
Settings Help and About rows are Pressable but have no onPress behavior; if these are intended as options, they are dead controls.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (login/dashboard/settings/language passed; logout not completed due missing reliable back/navigation selector)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Default account language is Hindi. Public preview: https://krishismart-app.preview.emergentagent.com. Visible RN web controls are not native button tags; prefer text or aria selectors until testIDs are added.
rca_of_issue: The logout step was blocked by testability rather than a confirmed product failure: bottom navigation labels changed after selecting English and the settings back Pressable has no accessibilityLabel/testID. Add stable identifiers and rerun the full flow.
